Formats are deliverables, including xlsx/docx/pptx; the official HTML financial demo is an output showcase, not an autonomous manager account.

code_research.redirect_verified: https://github.com/anthropics/financial-services-plugins redirects to current financial-services repo; not a second current package
code_research.scope: Read-only primary-source inspection; no plugin install, provider auth, real financial run or output-quality test.

layers.finding: Name/version/description/author metadata, not an autonomous runtime.
Explicit slash action loads initiating-coverage skill and requires company input.
Markdown task methodology + prerequisites + output contracts; one task per request, explicit next task; references only loaded for selected step.
Remote HTTP MCP provider endpoints; server internals/data schemas/auth/account subscriptions not implemented by this file.
Role prompt, tool names, model-selection/audit workflow, skill list and review checkpoints; uses historicals/consensus/filings from providers.

example_chain.initiation: Company+ticker → filings/user financials → Task1 research.md & Task2 linked model.xlsx → Task3 valuation.md+model tabs → Task4 PNG charts ZIP → Task5 report.docx. Tasks are explicitly invoked and prerequisites inspected, not an auto scheduler.
example_chain.earnings: Company+quarter → release/10-Q/transcript/investor material/consensus with dates → beat/miss+guidance+thesis update → Python charts → DOCX report with linked citations; optional workbook update.
example_chain.thesis: Company+existing thesis+new evidence supplied by user → evidence date & pillar impact & conviction log → scorecard & catalyst calendar → Markdown/Word. Structured storage across sessions is an instruction but schema/store/runtime not supplied in skill.

calculation.finding: Office add-in writes Excel formulas via Office JS and uses native Excel calculation. Standalone xlsx uses Python/openpyxl then requires recalc.py; data priority MCP, supplied data, web. Not all calculations done in model text.
Headless Managed mode writes Python script, executes via Bash, saves ./out/name.xlsx, returns path for orchestration layer; when live mcp__office__excel_* present prefer those.
Validation loads formula+cached-value workbooks, checks errors and DCF properties. This validates outputs; is not a complete finance engine.
Explicit Python matplotlib/seaborn/pandas/numpy/plotly chart generation instructions.
DOCX/XLSX skills load previous artifacts, insert figures/tables/hyperlinks and produce report.

boundaries: No reusable Text2SQL execution service evidenced by reviewed files; MCP is a tool protocol, not proof of SQL.
No evidence here of proprietary frontier model internal architecture, training recipe, data-provider normalization implementation, or production UI backend.
thesis-tracker quarterly review and structured persistence are desired behavior instructions, not proof of autonomous schedule/database/memory service.

README describes staged analyst work for human sign-off, not autonomous trade execution; some older vertical templates contain rating/target/action output, which is draft analysis not broker API execution.
Per-skill limitations differ: initiating-coverage explicitly cannot chain all tasks, even though new named-agent wrappers support end-to-end workflow roles.

Current financial-analysis .mcp.json fails JSON parsing at line47 at this SHA. Treat as reference implementation and do not claim plug-and-play readiness. Source code instructions and live service quality are distinct.
